authorization: User request on 2026-09-15 for a detailed analysis of the completed G0-G2 v5 qualification.

supersedes_protocol.reason: Numerically valid and kept; three figure defects failed visual QA: crowded G1 tick labels, the Amdahl floor annotation overprinting the bars, and the extrapolation caveat text overlapping the bar. Plot-only change; no analysis rule, threshold or number changed.

questions: how much gate margin does G1 have, sample by sample
which G2 object carries the largest CPU/GPU deviation and how large is it
where does the remaining end-to-end solve time sit, i.e. the Amdahl decomposition and the floor that survives an infinitely fast GPU
what do the measured per-solve times imply for the full 2379-cycle route, labelled as extrapolation
claims_allowed: G1 reproduces the CPU predictor at six fixed samples with the frozen gate six orders of magnitude from binding
the GPU-built fixed QP is numerically identical to the CPU-built one and the first control agrees to 1e-10 or better
on the two registered fixed samples the GPU path is 3.256x faster end to end and inside the original 5 s per-solve budget
about 48 percent of the GPU solve is now CPU-side work that the GPU does not touch
claims_forbidden: any closed-loop, full-route or real-time claim
any claim that the GPU changes the P1 late tracking divergence
any distributed, communication or Koopman-superiority claim
presenting the full-route hours projection as a measurement
expected_figures: G1 gate utilisation per sample and quantity
Amdahl decomposition of the fixed-sample solve
identity_rule: Only immutable inputs are gated: the frozen v5 protocol, its four result JSONs, the P1 solver log used for the measured per-cycle baseline, and this tool.
